_comment: Tier-2 for Kratos dem#3: DEM is always 3D internally — MDPA must use SphericParticle3D even for 2D problems. There is no SphericParticle2D registered. ModelPart.CreateNewElement('SphericParticle2D', ...) raises RuntimeError 'Element "SphericParticle2D" is not registered!'. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 creates the registered SphericParticle3D instead of the unregistered SphericParticle2D, so the element is created. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: RuntimeError, is not registered. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_spheric_particle_2d_rejected && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers. FIXED 2026-08-08: the expectation 'SphericParticle2D' was a bare word this fixture writes in its own error arm (print("ERROR: SphericParticle2D accepted...")), so it matched whether Kratos rejected the name or accepted it. Replaced by Kratos's own sentence, 'The Element "SphericParticle2D" is not registered', which only Kratos can produce and which names the element rather than merely proving that something raised.
_key_correction: Was keyed dem::1. dem::1 is '[Input] DEM builds four mdpa filenames by concatenating problem_name with fixed tags', which this fixture does not test. It creates elements, and the only thing it establishes is that SphericParticle2D is not registered -- the first half of dem::13. Re-keyed 2026-08-07. NOTE: dem::13 is also covered, more completely, by dem_has_real_2d_cylinder_particles, which pins BOTH halves (the unregistered SphericParticle2D and the registered CylinderParticle2D / CylinderContinuumParticle2D). This fixture is therefore redundant rather than load-bearing, and the coverage report will show dem::13 double-counted. It is kept, not deleted, because it still executes and still fails if Kratos ever registers SphericParticle2D.
_merge_note: MERGED 2026-08-08 from two branches that changed different things here. feature/kratos-generator re-keyed the claim (covers dem::13 plus _key_correction: it was keyed dem::1, a pitfall about mdpa filenames that this fixture does not test). fix/wrong-assertions tightened the assertion: the bare needles 'SphericParticle2D' and 'is not registered' were each satisfiable on their own, so the full sentence is asserted instead. Neither supersedes the other and taking one side alone dropped the other's fix, so both are kept.
